CustomObject.label: Device Command
CustomObject.description: A command queued for a physical device. Custom on purpose: no standard object models an auditable device-command lifecycle (Pending/Sent/Acked/Failed). Each new Pending command goes to its board through the device API (DeviceCommandTrigger, then DeviceCommandSendJob), and the board's answer comes back through DeviceCommandAckService as Acked or Failed.
